title: Payment screen in one column on phones
description: On a phone the payment drawer (decision dialog) laid out in two columns: the flex-column drawer had flex-wrap: wrap on phone widths, so with a bounded height the planet list, hint and buttons wrapped into a second column past the right edge of the screen. It is one column again (summary, planets, hint, buttons, all full width), and the footer with the Pay button stays sticky also on short landscape phones. The same drawer serves resource and influence payments, production and other spends. Before shots were taken with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before on the commit without the fix; after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- EQ, which also asserts no horizontal overflow, one left edge and a fully visible Pay button on phones. Mocked fixtures.

notes.title: Cause and scope
notes.text: index.css (max-width: 720px): .decision-modal .payment-drawer had flex-wrap: wrap, meant for the reaction bar. Only PaymentDrawer uses it; PaymentBar, TokenPaymentBar and ReadyPlanetsBar are bars without that rule. web2 has no payment drawer; the alpha serves web/dist, whose CSS has the same rule.
